Kanki - Kindle reviewer layer over Ranki
build=93be8aa
built=2026-08-22

Rendering, audio and the reviewer shell are provided by libkanki-webkit-*.so.
Everything else in this package is unchanged from the upstream Ranki release
and the Anki 26.08 backend it was assembled with.

Type is governed by a floor and a ceiling. Each card is measured, scaled so
its smallest substantial text reaches the floor, and anything the scaling
cannot reach is truncated into range. A deck's own proportions survive
between the limits.

Layout settings live at the top of ranki.sh and take effect on the next
launch. The gear at the bottom left of a card adjusts most of them on the
device itself, for the current run.

Diagnostics are off, and a launch with them off clears whatever an earlier
diagnostic run left behind. Create a file named "enable-log" next to this one
to collect ranki.log, and "enable-render-debug" to also capture per-render
HTML and computed layout.
